note: Recorded by hand from https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_regions.html plus the two tables recovered from the HTML into the .supplement.txt file. The page is a list of regional differences under one heading, using bold run-in headings. The baseline those differences are stated against is the page's own words: "the AWS Regions where GuardDuty is available". The page does not enumerate that set; its first sentence defines it by reference to the GuardDuty endpoints page in the AWS General Reference, which is the list services.json carries for guardduty (source general-reference-endpoints): 44 of the 46 Regions. So covered = those 44, minus the Regions each heading names, and excluded = the Regions the heading names plus the 2 Regions GuardDuty is not offered in. The two lists still add up to 46, as universe-minus-exclusions requires. AWS Dedicated Local Zones are not Regions and never appear in covered or excluded.

baseline.statement: To view the AWS Regions where Amazon GuardDuty is available, see Amazon GuardDuty endpoints in the Amazon Web Services General Reference.
baseline.why: regions.json holds 46 Regions; services.json guardduty.regions holds 44. Counting the missing 2 as covered would claim a GuardDuty feature runs where GuardDuty does not, which the DoH/DoT heading in particular contradicts in the same sentence it is quoted from.

featureNotes.guardduty/rds-protection-regions: Heading "RDS Protection". The page says RDS Protection is not supported in Asia Pacific (Taipei) (ap-east-2) Region. 44 baseline Regions - 1 named = 43 covered; excluded = ap-east-2 plus the 2 Regions without GuardDuty. The second sentence excludes AWS Dedicated Local Zones, which are not Regions, so it is not counted anywhere.
featureNotes.guardduty/finding-credentialaccess-iamus: Heading "IAM finding type - CredentialAccess:IAMUser/CompromisedCredentials". The sentence says the finding type is not supported in the following regions, and recovered Table 1 names four: AWS GovCloud (US-West), AWS GovCloud (US-East), China (Beijing), China (Ningxia). 44 - 4 = 40 covered; 6 excluded. The four are counted as Regions, not partitions, because the table gives Region codes.
featureNotes.guardduty/finding-defenseevasion-iamuser: Heading "IAM finding type - DefenseEvasion:IAMUser/BedrockLoggingDisabled". One named unsupported Region, Asia Pacific (Hong Kong) (ap-east-1). 44 - 1 = 43 covered; 3 excluded.
featureNotes.guardduty/finding-defenseevasion-ec2-unu: Heading "Amazon EC2 finding types - DefenseEvasion:EC2/UnusualDoHActivity and DefenseEvasion:EC2/UnusualDoTActivity". The sentence states the baseline outright: the table shows the AWS Regions where GuardDuty is available but these two finding types are not yet supported. Recovered Table 2 names three: Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Osaka), Asia Pacific (Jakarta). 44 - 3 = 41 covered; 5 excluded.

headingsWithNoFeature.Expanded filterable fields for CreateFil: States availability by partition (aws), not by Region, and says other partitions keep the console-supported fields. A partition is not a Region, and turning partition membership into a Region list would be inference. No feature.
headingsWithNoFeature.ListFindings and GetFindingsStatistics A: Describes an API result limit, names no Region. No feature.
headingsWithNoFeature.Malware Protection for EC2: Its only statement is support in AWS Dedicated Local Zones, which are not Regions. No countable Region coverage, so no feature and no invented Region.
headingsWithNoFeature.AI Protection finding types: Coverage is conditional on Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI and Bedrock Guardrails availability and no Region is named on this page. No feature.
headingsWithNoFeature.General API support: Lists API operations, which are not axis items, and names no Region. No feature.
headingsWithNoFeature.AWS GovCloud (US) Regions: Only a pointer to the AWS GovCloud (US) User Guide. A pointer is not coverage. No feature.
headingsWithNoFeature.China Regions: Only a pointer to the China documentation. No feature.

caveat: Every covered Region except the ones a heading names carries the same quote: the sentence naming the exceptions. It is evidence for that Region only if this section really is the complete list of regional differences, which is what the section says it is. That is the weakest evidence in the dataset and each feature carries a note saying so. The page also defers GovCloud and China feature differences to other guides, yet names all four of those Regions as exceptions under one heading, so they stay inside this list.

features.name: GuardDuty EC2 finding types DefenseEvasion:EC2/UnusualDoHActivity and DefenseEvasion:EC2/UnusualDoTActivity
